On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''tower''' was controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] officer [[Mar Barezz]] used the tower as his base of operations while on the planet investigating new Rebels being recruited by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agent [[Tay Vanis]].
